verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official MCP server explicitly for 'searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues' (sentry-docs-8, sentry-probe-3) plus a documented issues API for bulk mutation and third-party integrations (sentry-docs-23, sentry-docs-11) that could push triaged issues to a tracker. However, there's no explicit documented workflow or example showing stack-trace retrieval + filing into an external tracker (e.g., Jira/Linear) end-to-end, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming the MCP server's issue-filing or stack-trace-pull behavior in practice. Missing for 10: explicit stack-trace-via-MCP example, documented tracker-filing integration flow, independent corroboration of MCP triage-to-ticket usage.
